final_message:
I haven't fixed this, because the fix is in `config/`, which you told me not to touch.

The cause is `uploads.maxMb` in `config/default.json`, which is set to `5`. `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so it rejects an 8 MB file. The same value feeds `src/api/body-limit.js`. Two of the four tests fail for this reason. The "accepts an 8 MB PDF" test fails, and so does the 12 MB rejection test, which expects "max 10 MB" in the message but gets "max 5 MB".

The fix is one line, changing `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10`. It needs ops review, so someone on that team would have to make or approve it. Raising the limit also raises the API body limit from 6 MB to 11 MB, which ops will want to know.

I could instead hardcode 10 in `src/config.js` to override the config value. I'd advise against that. It would leave two conflicting sources of truth, and production reads `config/` directly, so it would behave differently from what the code shows. It would also bypass the ops review you want on this setting.

Tell me if you want the override anyway, or if you'd rather I draft the change and a note for ops.
